title: Late Charge Schedule: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Classes
content:
Late charges on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement are set per unit class. This schedule lists the class figures; each column is defined beneath the tables.

## Grace period, late-fee floor, percentage and ceiling

| Unit class | Grace period after the due date | Flat late-fee floor | Late-fee percentage of monthly rent | Late-fee ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 5 calendar days | $20.00 | 20% | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 5 calendar days | $20.00 | 20% | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 5 calendar days | $25.00 | 15% | $55.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 5 calendar days | $25.00 | 15% | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 7 calendar days | $30.00 | 10% | $75.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 7 calendar days | $30.00 | 10% | $75.00 |

## Second late fee and courtesy allowance

| Unit class | Second late fee assessed on day | Second late fee | Courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months | Months since move-in before a courtesy waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 15 after the due date | $15.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 15 after the due date | $15.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 15 after the due date | $15.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 15 after the due date | $20.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 20 after the due date | $25.00 | 2 | 3 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 20 after the due date | $25.00 | 2 | 3 |

## Column definitions

- **Grace period** — calendar days after a rent due date during which rent may be paid without a late fee.
- **Flat late-fee floor** — the class's flat late-fee floor, in US dollars.
- **Late-fee percentage** — the class's late fee as a fraction of the monthly rent.
- **Late-fee ceiling** — the most one late fee can be, in US dollars.
- **Second late fee assessed on day** — the calendar day after the rent due date at which a second late fee is assessed if that period's rent is still unpaid; the second late fee is the dollar amount beside it.
- **Courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months** — courtesy late-fee waivers allowed per rental agreement in any rolling 365-day window.
- **Months since move-in before a courtesy waiver** — calendar months that must have passed since move-in before a tenant may receive a courtesy waiver.

## Class comparisons

- The two Standard classes share every figure in both tables.
- The Bluegate Climate Controlled and Bluegate Climate Plus classes share a $25.00 floor and a 15% percentage, but the Climate Plus ceiling is $60.00 against $55.00, and its second late fee is $20.00 against $15.00.
- The Bluegate Premier Climate Suite and the Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault have a 7-day grace period, a second late fee on day 20, two courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months and a 3-month tenure for courtesy waivers.
